lang.name: Twi
verdict.pctMean: {v}% wɔ ne nyinaa mu mfeɛ du biara
verdict.whyGrade: Deɛ enti a ɛnya saa gredi yi
verdict.notEstablished: Ɛnna adi pefee. Data no mma adanseɛ a ɛyɛ den sɛ nsakraeɛ bi rekɔ so wɔ ha (gredi {g}).
verdict.yearsToSig: Mfeɛ a ɛho hia ansa na yɛate ase (nsusuiɛ): bɛyɛ {n}.
verdict.shift: Ebia nsakraeɛ mpofirim bi baeɛ bɛyɛ {date}
verdict.shiftTail: Ɛbia line tee baako ntumi nkyerɛ saa nkrataa yi yie.
verdict.aiWording: AI aboa kasa no; nɔma no firi nhwehwɛmu no mu.
verdict.englishNote: Nsɛm anan a ɛwɔ ha no firi nhwehwɛmu no mu, ɛwɔ Borɔfo kasa mu.
case.title: Kumasi reyɛ hyew ankasa?
case.intro: Nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ Kumasi ka sɛ nna no ayɛ hyew na nsuo tɔ no nso nni ahotoso. Yɛbisaa NASA satellite nkrataa no.
case.clue.title: Nsɛnkyerɛnne
case.clue.body: Atenka nyɛ adanseɛ. Nnawɔtwe a ɛyɛ hyew no tena adwene mu, na afe baako tumi yɛ soronko. Sɛ yɛpɛ sɛ yɛhunu sɛ beaeɛ bi resakra ankasa a, ɛhia mfeɛ du du pii susudua ne nhwehwɛmu a ɛteneɛ.
case.evidence.title: Adanseɛ
case.evidence.body: Kumasi wim ɔhyew ɔsram biara, a yɛayi mmerɛ no afiri mu sɛdeɛ nsakraeɛ tenten no nko ara bɛda adi. Line a ɛyɛ duruduru no ne ɔkwan no.
case.twist.title: Nsɛm a ɛdane
case.twist.body: Nsuo tɔ ka asɛm foforɔ. Kuro koro no ara so, mmuaeɛ no mmda adi pefee, na West Africa nyinaa mu, mmeaeɛ bi reyɛ fɔkyee bere a afoforɔ reyɛ wesee.
case.verdict.title: Atemmuo
case.cannot.title: Deɛ yɛntumi nka
case.cannot.cause: Deɛ enti a ɛresakra. Nsakraeɛ a ɛda adi nkyerɛ ne fibea.
case.cannot.shape: Sɛ nsakraeɛ no yɛ line tee anaa. Adwinnadeɛ yi hwehwɛ nsakraeɛ a ɛkɔ ɔkwan baako so nko ara.
case.cannot.future: Deɛ ɛbɛba daakye. Yeinom yɛ nsakraeɛ a atwam, ɛnyɛ nkɔmhyɛ.
